I'm super excited to hear that Rockstar Games has worked on GTA 6 single player economy to the point where some missions won't even start unless you have the money required to do so.

Jason and Lucia being constantly on the run means that you're constantly losing money and that fact alone means that half way through the story you can lose all of your money if things get out of hand.

Unpredictable moments like these can add a lot of value to the gameplay and it reinforces players to explore side missions instead of just finishing the main story.
